card.name: Verbs of needing, before fix-or-recover
card.fires_on: Small verbs such as be, to, required, needing or do that come right before an expected word about fixing, recovering, relief or intervention. They sit after phrases about needing, having to or being unable.

modes.label: Required or needing
modes.description: Verbs of requirement or necessity, often in adverse-reaction or medical-intervention text.
modes.example: Overall, 2.7% of all patients who received AYVAKIT<< required>> permanent discontinuation for a cognitive adverse reaction

modes.label: Having to redo or recover
modes.description: The word to or a linking verb after had, wants or needing, before a next step such as remaking, relieving or recovering.
modes.example: Who wants<< to>> have to remake the patterns year after year
